resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Brazilian Portuguese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Brazilian Portuguese pass identified 25 actionable formula, terminology, grammar, and technical-clarity defects across electrical, trigonometric, thermal, heat-flux, and unit content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Brazilian Portuguese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Ohm formula localized I.
evidence: The previous expression used eu.

findings.summary: The current definition repeated amperes.
evidence: The previous bullet repeated amperes.
findings.resolution: Changed it to corrente medida em amperes (A).

findings.summary: The current formula omitted division spacing.
evidence: The previous expression was Eu = V/R.

findings.summary: The resistance formula omitted division spacing.
evidence: The previous expression was R = V/I.

findings.summary: The electrical-power title used energy instead of power.
evidence: The previous title was Energia elétrica.

findings.summary: The power formula used spaced caret notation.
evidence: The previous expression used I ^ 2 and V ^ 2.
findings.resolution: Restored standard I^2 and V^2 notation.

findings.summary: The Joule formulas used inconsistent caret spacing.
evidence: The previous formulas used spaced exponents.
findings.resolution: Restored P = I^2 × R and P = V^2 / R.

findings.summary: The Joule example described power as joules per second.
evidence: The previous conclusion used 7,2 joules por segundo.
findings.resolution: Clarified 7,2 W and 72 J in 10 seconds.

findings.summary: The sine formula used unnecessary spacing and localized labels.
evidence: The previous expression was sin (θ) = oposto / hipotenusa.

findings.summary: The tangent formula localized side labels.
evidence: The previous expression used oposto and adjacente.

findings.summary: The trigonometry example localized sine and the opposite-side label.
evidence: The previous expression used sen and oposto.

findings.summary: The inverse-sine formula used spaced exponent syntax.
evidence: The previous expression used sin ^ -1.

findings.summary: The inverse-cosine formula used spaced exponent syntax and localized labels.
evidence: The previous expression used cos ^ -1 and adjacente.

findings.summary: The inverse-tangent formula used spaced exponent syntax.
evidence: The previous expression used tan ^ -1.

findings.summary: The trigonometric identity localized sine.
evidence: The previous expression used sen ^ 2.

findings.summary: The heat-capacity formula omitted division spacing.
evidence: The previous expression was C = Q/ΔT.

findings.summary: The temperature-difference formula omitted Celsius spacing.
evidence: The previous expression ended with 50°C.

findings.summary: The heating-time formula omitted division spacing.
evidence: The previous expression ended with ΔT/P.
findings.resolution: Restored t = m × c × ΔT / P.

findings.summary: The heating conclusion spelled out the validated seconds result.
evidence: The previous conclusion ended with 523 segundos.

findings.summary: The phase limitation used specific heat rather than specific heat capacity.
evidence: The previous paragraph used calor específico.
findings.resolution: Changed it to capacidade térmica específica.

findings.summary: The heat-flux formula localized the heat-rate variable.
evidence: The previous expression used Q_ponto.

findings.summary: The heat-flux example needed normalized unit spacing.
evidence: The previous expression lacked consistent spaces around units.

findings.summary: The conduction formulas localized protected labels and omitted spacing.
evidence: The previous formulas used Q_ponto and ΔT/L.

findings.summary: The convection paragraph used surface coefficient instead of convection coefficient.
evidence: The previous paragraph used coeficiente de superfície.
findings.resolution: Changed it to coeficiente de convecção.
